scripts.intended_objective: Operator 1 reopens the first gate as courier 0 enters; operator 2 opens the second on its entry call. Cargo 0 delivery is intended; cargo 1 remains.
Move both operators to their lower stations and courier 0 to cargo 1, then use the corresponding two lower gates. Only cargo 1 delivery is intended.
